text_block_list.text:
The final day of training at the summer 
camp has arrived...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
*Pant, pant*... Phew. 
...Well? How was that?

I drew a line through the final checklist 
item 
on my tablet.

I knew full well how grueling this regimen 
was. 
...Yet she saw it through to the end. 
She answered every expectation I placed 
upon her!
choice_data_list: Thank you for pushing through it all...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Heh, what a peculiar thing to say.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I have merely undertaken the training 
necessary to secure victory.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
'Tis I who should be grateful. 
For pushing me with all your heart and 
soul.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Did Phalaenopsis prove to be a talent 
worthy of your expectations?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us go claim it. 
—The finest of results.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh! 
Good work out there, Phalaeno.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You really, how should I put it... 
pushed yourself this summer. I've been 
watching.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Only because of the training I 
shared with you. 
With that foundation, I was able to push 
myself this summer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Once again, you have my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh, is that so...? If it serves 
your future in any way, then I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, during this summer training 
camp, 
I have not seen Brian once. 
What has become of her?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Brian, you say? 
Hmph... I suppose it wouldn't hurt to tell 
you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The truth is—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Are you content merely gazing at the 
track?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Tch. 
If you want someone to chat with, find 
someone else.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Do not be so cold. 
Are we not kin, after all?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I heard you haven't been in good form. 
How have you been lately?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
......*sigh*. 
Why does family always have to be so damn 
annoying?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's none of your business.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: It is my business.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Once, I yearned for that stride of yours. 
You are 
one of the brilliant stars I intend to 
grasp in these hands.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It would not do for you to fall of your 
own accord.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Surely you don't intend to stop here? 
Not you, who stoked the embers within me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hah. Look who's talking. 
Since when did you get big enough to 
lecture me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The Shuka Sho won't be a walk in the park. 
Humiliate yourself, and I'll laugh.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, watch with that very expectation. 
For this time, it is I who—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Shall stoke the embers within your heart.

Overcoming the harsh summer—autumn 
arrives. The next race 
is the third jewel of the Triple Tiara, 
the Shuka Sho.
